If the Alchemical Chest was a mastery of spatial expansion, the Alchemical Bag is an absolute triumph of spatial compression. By weaving hyper-dense alchemical threads and pocket-dimension arrays into a piece of portable fabric, you have effectively created a handheld Alchemical Chest. You are absolutely going to love this artifact—it is an incredibly powerful backpack that will instantly render your standard woven satchels and heavy crates completely obsolete! It is time to carry a factory's worth of resources right in your pocket.

Functionally, this bag provides a massive, portable inventory space. However, it operates on a very specific quantum-entanglement principle: §lBags of the same color share the exact same inventory space, much like an Ender Chest.
§r
Because of this color-coded network, the bag acts as an integrated pagination system. If you leave a Red Bag at your base pumping items into an AE2 network, you can use another Red Bag in the mining dimension to send items straight home! Just keep in mind that because of this shared-color mechanic, you effectively have §la maximum of 48 distinct "pages" (or networks)§r of storage available by default. Use your colors wisely to organize your sprawling industrial logistics!
